System requirements

Windows

  • ✓ Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • ✓ 4 GB RAM minimum, 8 GB recommended
  • ✓ OpenGL 3.3 or DirectX 11
  • ✓ 500 MB disk space

macOS

  • ✓ macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • ✓ 4 GB RAM minimum, 8 GB recommended
  • ✓ Metal GPU support
  • ✓ 500 MB disk space

Linux

  • ✓ Ubuntu 22.04 / Fedora 38 or equivalent
  • ✓ 4 GB RAM minimum, 8 GB recommended
  • ✓ OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • ✓ 500 MB disk space

Build from source

Requires Rust (stable toolchain via rustup), Node.js 22+, and pnpm 10+. 

git clone https://github.com/pixhaus-app/pixhaus
cd pixhaus
pnpm bootstrap
pnpm dev

See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full setup guide.
